title: Exclusive-Intel, AMD sign long-term server CPU deals with Chinese clients as prices surge, sources say
title_zh: 独家消息：消息人士称，随着价格飙升，英特尔、AMD 与中国客户签署长期服务器 CPU 协议
summary: U.S. chipmaking giants Intel and Advanced Micro Devices are signing longer-term purchase commitments with Chinese server customers for data-centre processors as prices ‌surge, two people familiar with the talks said.
summary_zh: 两位知情人士表示，随着价格飙升，美国芯片制造巨头英特尔和 Advanced Micro Devices 正在与中国服务器客户签署数据中心处理器的长期采购承诺。

title: SK Hynix denies Intel Ohio fab deal, but the market didn't care
title_zh: SK海力士否认英特尔俄亥俄州晶圆厂交易，但市场并不在意
summary: A report out of South Korea on Tuesday, July 21, claimed SK Hynix was in talks to buy Intel’s unfinished Ohio semiconductor campus, according to Stocktwits.
summary_zh: 据 Stocktwits 报道，7 月 21 日星期二，韩国发布的一份报告称，SK 海力士正在就收购英特尔未完工的俄亥俄州半导体园区进行谈判。

title: Wall Street Banks Trading Parts of $35 Billion AI Chip Deal
title_zh: 华尔街银行交易部分 350 亿美元人工智能芯片交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Wall Street banks have started buying and selling an initial piece of a $35 billion financing package for Broadcom Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——华尔街银行已开始买卖博通公司 350 亿美元融资计划的初始部分。

title: AMD, Cerebras Strike AI Chip Deals
title_zh: AMD 与 Cerebras 达成人工智能芯片交易
summary: Advanced Micro Devices and Cerebras Systems on Wednesday separately announced partnerships related to their AI chips. AMD stock and Cerebras stock rose on the news as semiconductor stocks overall advanced.
summary_zh: Advanced Micro Devices 和 Cerebras Systems 周三分别宣布了与其人工智能芯片相关的合作伙伴关系。随着半导体股整体上涨，AMD 股票和 Cerebras 股票受此消息上涨。

title: KKR-Backed Vertis Nears $800 Million India Roads Acquisition
title_zh: KKR 支持的 Vertis 斥资近 8 亿美元收购印度道路
summary: Vertis is in advanced talks to buy eight road assets from Megha Engineering, valued at about $800 million including debt.
summary_zh: Vertis 正在就从 Megha Engineering 购买八项道路资产进行深入谈判，包括债务在内，价值约为 8 亿美元。
